answer: Weight each grade by whether the grader is already established — challenge-eligible in a prior epoch — not merely present. A fresh identity emits only a weak signal: it may submit grades, but they carry no settlement power until the identity itself has crossed the ridge of a passed, peer-confirmed epoch. A flood of day-old fakes grading one another stays in the umber shadow below that threshold, unable to manufacture finality from nothing. Trust compounds only through prior proven work.
